reader_summary.overview: This is Dom Cooke and today we’re breaking down Harvard Business Publishing. The media arm of Harvard’s world-famous business school was founded in the early 90s, but the seeds were sown a century ago, in 1922. 100 years on, this secretive business has been through significant change.

key_points.text: The media arm of Harvard’s world-famous business school was founded in the early 90s, but the seeds were sown a century ago, in 1922.
But the roots of influencing managers through academic research remain firmly intact.
And despite its not-for-profit status, Harvard Business Publishing generates an impressive and growing income stream for its parent institution.
